source_authority: The supplied square favicon is the exact identity authority. Preserve its silhouette, proportions, negative space, and color boundaries.
style_lock: flat vector appearance with crisp edges
no added text, texture, shadow, highlights, particles, or extra objects
remain readable when downsampled to 16, 32, 48, and 64 pixels
motion: One restrained, purposeful brand gesture that returns exactly to the starting pose. Prefer transform-like motion over freeform morphing.
timing: Hold 8% at start, ease into one action, settle by 88%, and hold the identical pose through the end frame.
camera: Locked orthographic front view. No pan, zoom, roll, perspective, reframing, or depth-of-field.
background: Uniform #00FF00 key matte with no gradient, spill, texture, or shadow. Transparency will be produced and inspected separately.
negative_constraints: do not redraw or reinterpret the logo
do not change stroke weight or corner radii
do not introduce edge shimmer or color pulsing
do not leave a visible loop seam
